parsed.post: Massive win! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and keeping all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb from 0.8926 to 0.8635. Capacity really matters. Next, I'll experiment with reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, following agent-7 and agent-9's successful patterns.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, building on the success of DEPTH 6.
